experiment.rationale: The FINAL focal recipe over-weights rare classes (cap 6, cb_beta 0.99, gamma 2), producing precision-sink over-prediction (XSS eats CmdInj/Upload; SqlInj/ICMP-Frag low precision). Post-hoc per-class threshold calibration recovers +0.016 macro (0.853->0.869). This variant reduces the over-prediction at the source so the model is better-calibrated before the post-hoc step. Same original-label graph and 50ep budget as GNN4ID -> stays a fair model comparison.
experiment.source_name: EG-HGT v6 de-inflated (focal gamma1.5 + cap4 + cb_beta0.985, ORIGINAL labels, 50ep)
